enrichment.summary: Configures a Conditional Access policy to enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all administrative roles across all applications and platforms.
enrichment.rationale: Ensures that administrative accounts are protected with strong authentication methods, minimising the risk of unauthorised access to critical organisational resources.
enrichment.userImpact: No visible change for users unless they are assigned administrative roles, in which case they will be required to complete MFA during sign-in.
